[size=6][b]Documentation:[/b][/size][/center]
[i](Shane always has post event dialogue. Some events have other villagers also have post event dialogue)[/i]

1 Heart Event:
[i](in Town; from 9:00am to 4:00pm)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The Guy working at Joja:[/b]
You have a short conversation with Shane while he works. He's so neglecting and guarded 😩 (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

2 Heart Event:
[i](in the Forest; from 4:30pm to 7:00pm; event 1 had to be seen)
(some people around town will comment on this. Click the spoiler if you want to know who)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Shane you seem off:[/b]
You see an interaction between a drunk Shane, Jas and Penny. (play to find out more)
People that will comment on this: Jas, Penny, Marnie[/SPOILER]

3 Heart Event:
[i](in Town; from 8:00pm to 10:00pm; event 2 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Working overtime:[/b]
Shane is really mad because he has to work overtime. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

4 Heart Event:
[i](a[i]t the Bus Stop; from 9:00am to 1:00pm;[/i] event 3 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]a nice hangout:[/b]
You spend some time with Shane at his favorite place in town and get to know each other a bit better. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

5 Heart Event:
[i](in Marnie's Farmhouse; event 4 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The letter:[/b]
Shane got a letter from his parents... and it does not look pretty. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

6 Heart Event:[i]
(in Town; from 6:00am to 2:00pm; event 5 had to be seen)
(A lot of people will comment on this around town. Click the spoiler if you want to know who)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Hot dad alert:[/b]
Shane's Dad confronts him in the center of the town for everyone to see. (play to find out more)
People that will comment on this: Jas, Penny, Marnie, Jodi, Caroline, Gus, Emily, Lewis, Harvey, Pierre, Evelyn[/SPOILER]

7 Heart Event:
[i][u]PART 1:[/u] (wake up in your Farmhouse while at 7 hearts; no festivals the following day; event 6 had to be seen; Marnie will comment on this if spoken to)
[u]PART 2:[/u] (Enter the Forest the following day; from 9:00pm to 11:00pm)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Bro just left?:[/b]
Shane left town to visit someone... I wonder who he visited 🤔 he wants to better himself now (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

8 Heart Event:[i]
(in Town; from 6:00am to 12:00pm; event 7 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Too much beer for Shane:[/b]
Shane ended up in the clinic with alcohol poisoning. Thank yoba we have the best doctor in the valley. Shane realises that he can't take this journey by himself and seek helps from his friends and loved ones. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

9 Heart Event:
[i](at the Bus Stop; from 7:00am to 11:00am; event 8 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Visiting Shane's best friend:[/b]
Shane invites you to go visit his best friends grave together. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

10 Heart Event:[i]
(in the Saloon; from 5:00pm to 9:00pm; event 9 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]A heartfelt speech:[/b]
Shane holds a speech about his journey, confessing his love for you. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

[b]﻿﻿﻿[/b][size=6][b]Frequently asked questions:[/b]
[/size]
Q: Is the mod compatible with [color=#f1c232][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#f1c232]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url]﻿[/color]?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] The events account for if Stardew Expanded is installed or not.

Q: Is the mod compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22955][color=#f1c232]Immersive Characters - Shane[/color][/url]﻿?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes! [/color]This mod only adds more events and does not touch Shane gameplay wise.
The stories also line up quite well if you ask me.

Q: Is the mod compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5070][color=#f1c232]The Ranch Expansion Marnie and Jas[/color][/url]﻿?
A: [color=#cc0000]Not really...[/color][color=#6aa84f] [/color]Well technically yes, you can play with both mod installed without problems.
I never played it myself but community members that have say that the narratives of both mods don't align.

Q: Will the events work if I [color=#ffd966]don't have Joja Mart in town[/color] anymore?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color][color=#93c47d] [/color]I have decided to make it work as if Joja is still in town.
This way people that want to play it on a late game file can still enjoy the mod without going through loopholes 

Q: Can I make a [color=#f1c232]translation of/expand on[/color] this mod?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] Please read the permissions and credits tab first! (no AI)
please make sure to use the correct i18n format.
If you want to use the commissioned artwork for your translation, make sure to credit the original artist.

Q: Can I use your [color=#f1c232]assets[/color]?
A: Short answer is [color=#cc0000]no.[/color] But you can reach out to me on Discord to ask for permission (username: Miihau).

Q: Is this mod compatible with [color=#f1c232]mobile[/color]?
A: [color=#cc0000][/color][color=#6aa84f]I think so?[/color][color=#cc0000] [/color]Please make sure to use the latest version or SMAPI and Content Patcher for Stardew Valley 1.6.

Q: Will [color=#f1c232]portrait mods[/color] for Shane still work?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] the mod only adds a Joja-uniform portrait for the first event (the rest will be your portrait mod you have installed).

Q: Can I still see the events if I'm [color=#f1c232]already married[/color] to Shane (or on an already existing save file)?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] You can still see all the event in the intended order.

Q: Will Shane's [color=#f1c232]behavior change[/color]?
A:[color=#cc0000] No! [/color]This mod does not change his behavior. He will still have beer as a loved gift.

Q: Can I [color=#f1c232]marry Shane's Dad[/color]?
A: [color=#cc0000]No![/color] He is happily married and we do not support homewreckers.

Q: Can I use your mod as a [color=#f1c232]template to learn[/color]?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Sure[/color], feel free to learn from it. Just don't blatantly copy whole chunks.

Q: Will you make a [color=#f1c232]mod for [insert your favorite NPC here][/color]?
A: So far I have mods for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17674][color=#d5a6bd][u]Haley[/u][/color][/url]﻿,[color=#f4cccc][b] [/b][/color][color=#8e7cc3][b][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18657][color=#8e7cc3]Abigail[/color][/url]﻿[/u][/b] [/color]and [color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16279][u]Penny[/u][/url]﻿[/color].
I really want to make a mod for all the NPCs, but currently I have my eye on [color=#6aa84f]Leah[/color] and [color=#76a5af]Harvey[/color].
